cover:scientists.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat in an old laboratory full of bubbling flasks, a microscope and a glowing light bulb

cover:space_travel.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat looking out of a round spaceship window at the blue Earth, a sailboat and a mountain map pinned nearby

kids_heroes:3.p: A boy on a frosty porch in the morning discovering a glass of frozen soda with a stirring stick stuck inside, delighted surprise

kids_heroes:4.p: A teenage boy on a frozen pond skating rink wearing homemade fluffy ear warmers on a bent wire band, rosy cheeks, snowy day

kids_heroes:5.p: A teenage girl holding a small glowing flashlight powered by the warmth of her palm, lighting up a friend's homework in the evening

kids_heroes:6.p: A teenage boy on a boat looking at a long floating barrier collecting plastic from a sparkling blue ocean, fish swimming happily below

cover:writers_artists.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat in a cozy study with an easel, piles of books, a quill pen and a seascape painting

cover:sport_heroes.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat wearing a gold medal on a winners podium in a stadium with confetti

sport_heroes:6.p: joyful athletes in wheelchairs and with running prosthetics racing on a stadium track, cheering crowd, confetti

cover:doctors_rescuers.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat and a little doctor coat with a stethoscope standing beside a rescue team in orange uniforms

doctors_rescuers:4.p: A kind old doctor with a gentle smile visiting a poor family's small home, a little dog and a cat waiting by the door

doctors_rescuers:6.p: A team of rescuers in orange uniforms and helmets helping people into a rescue boat on a flooded street, calm and brave

cover:animal_heroes.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat standing proudly with a loyal sled dog, a big Saint Bernard and a ship's cat

animal_heroes:5.p: a brave german shepherd dog with a medal on a harness, standing proudly beside a soldier in an old green uniform, spring field

animal_heroes:6.p: a black and white ship cat sitting proudly on the deck of an old navy ship, sailors smiling, sea and gulls

cover:fail_to_win.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat climbing a staircase made of crumpled paper drafts toward a shining golden star

fail_to_win:4.p: A cheerful chemist in a lab coat sticking colorful paper notes all over a wall and a book, surprised and pleased

cover:kindness.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat handing a glowing heart-shaped lantern to a group of smiling volunteers at dusk

kindness:2.p: A six-year-old boy doing chores at home and dropping coins into a jar, dreaming of a new water well in a sunny village

kindness:3.p: A team of kids secretly stacking firewood and carrying water for an elderly neighbor's village house, summer evening

kindness:4.p: Volunteers in bright reflective vests with flashlights walking calmly through a forest at dusk, searching together

kindness:5.p: A kind smiling man resting in a comfy chair at a donation center, a friendly nurse beside him, heart decorations on the wall

cover:growth_mindset.p: A small fluffy ginger kitten detective in a tiny deerstalker hat lifting a tiny dumbbell next to a glowing brain-shaped plant growing new sprouts

growth_mindset:0.p: Two kids at desks with the same hard puzzle, one frowning and giving up, the other smiling and trying again with determination

growth_mindset:1.p: A girl standing at the start of a winding path up a hill toward a sunny summit, a backpack on her shoulders, hopeful look

growth_mindset:2.p: A cute cartoon brain doing push-ups with tiny glowing threads connecting inside it, a cheerful gym setting

growth_mindset:3.p: A cyclist team riding together while tiny improvements sparkle around them: a comfy pillow, clean hands, a better saddle

growth_mindset:4.p: An inventor child surrounded by many failed little prototypes, holding up one that finally glows, delighted

growth_mindset:5.p: A young swimmer on a starting block with eyes closed, imagining the whole race as a glowing dream above the pool

growth_mindset:6.p: A child looking into a mirror where a slightly younger version of themselves waves back, proud smile, cozy room

growth_mindset:7.p: A child sleeping peacefully in bed while tiny friendly helpers inside a dream bubble neatly stack books on shelves
